Run a job.

## Synopsis

```text
run job=<job> [client=<client>] [fd=<fd>] [fileset=<fileset>] [level=<level>]
    [storage=<storage>] [sd=<sd>] [where=<where>] [regexwhere=<regexwhere>]
    [bootstrap=<bootstrap>] [replace=<always|ifnewer|ifolder|never>]
    [when=<when>] [priority=<priority>] [verifyjob=<verifyjob>]
    [files=<files>] [catalog=<catalog>] [since=<since>] [cloned[=<cloned>]]
    [verifylist=<verifylist>] [migrationjob=<migrationjob>] [pool=<pool>]
    [nextpool=<nextpool>] [backupclient=<backupclient>]
    [restoreclient=<restoreclient>] [pluginoptions=<pluginoptions>]
    [spooldata=<yes|no>] [comment=<comment>] [ignoreduplicatecheck=<yes|no>]
    [accurate=<yes|no>] [jobid=<jobid>[,...]] [backupformat=<backupformat>]
    [consolidatejob=<consolidatejob>] [schedule=<schedule>] [yes]
```

Words without brackets are required, `[ ]` marks optional parts, `a | b` alternatives, `...` a repeatable argument and `[,...]` a comma separated list.

## Description

Starts a job. Missing values come from the Job resource; without yes the Director shows the job and asks yes, mod or no.

## Examples

Start a full backup without asking:

```text
run job=BackupClient1 level=Full yes
```

Show the job settings and ask yes, mod or no:

```text
run job=BackupClient1
```

Schedule an incremental for tomorrow night:

```text
run job=BackupClient1 level=Incremental pool=File when="2026-11-21 22:00:00" yes
```

Restore the files of job 42 without overwriting:

```text
run job=RestoreFiles jobid=42 where=/tmp/bareos-restores replace=never yes
```
